# Codec conformance fixtures

`big_buck_bunny_hevc_rgba.sha256` contains canonical `FrameDigest` values for
all 120 presentation frames in the repository's existing
`examples/media/BigBuckBunny.mp4` HEVC Main sample. The reference RGBA frames
were decoded with FFmpeg 6.0, then fingerprinted with the dimensions, RGBA8
format, limited color range, plane count, and active pixels defined by
`FrameDigest::from_frame`.

FFmpeg is only the offline fixture oracle. It is not a build, test, or runtime
dependency, and zvidlib's native codec implementations may not call or link it.

`av1_lossless_17x9.hex` is a standardized low-overhead AV1 temporal unit
generated by zvidlib's dependency-free native AV1 encoder at commit
`d09520cddddf39e154ae033ec69717e23f921a1c`. It is a reduced-still-picture,
Main-profile 8-bit monochrome key frame using one tile, static CDFs, DC intra
prediction, lossless 4x4 WHT coefficients, and odd coded dimensions. The
corresponding `av1_lossless_17x9_yuv420.sha256` is the canonical digest of its
full-range YUV420 output with neutral chroma. FFmpeg independently accepted the
encoder's standardized bitstream in the source branch's conformance test; the
decoder test itself is hermetic and uses no external codec.
